verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents docs-usage analytics: the 'API & Docs Metrics Charts' page and a Developer Metrics API to 'see how people use your docs'. Readers can share feedback through Suggest in GitHub. The evidence never names page views or search-term reporting, and the feedback channel is GitHub suggestions rather than in-page ratings tied to analytics. Missing for 10: explicit page-view metrics, search-term analytics, in-page reader feedback/ratings, independent corroboration.
